records.claim: Napier 2014 Lancet Commission 'Culture and health': culture shapes meaning of health, behaviour, trust, communities of care; theoretical basis, not efficacy evidence
Devakumar 2022 Lancet Series: racism, xenophobia, discrimination → health via segregation, hierarchy, stress, service exclusion, economic-political conditions
Selvarajah 2022 Lancet Series: mechanisms/pathways linking discrimination to health
Abubakar 2026 Lancet: UCL-Lancet Commission on migration and health follow-up; inclusive services, equitable access, rights, dignity, privacy, political determinants

Horvat 2014 Cochrane: cultural competence education for health professionals; 5 RCTs, 337 professionals, 8,400 patients; low-quality evidence; some improvement in involvement/understanding; no reliable clinical outcomes; adverse outcomes not assessed
Li 2023 Lancet Psychiatry: culturally adapted psychological interventions for common mental disorders in Chinese populations; review/meta-analysis; benefit population- and treatment-specific

Reaume 2025 JAMA Network Open: cohort 124,583 hypertensive patients; language-concordant care associated with lower major cardiovascular events among speakers of languages other than English/French/Indigenous; observational (find the correct PMID by title)

Axinn 2022 JAMA Psychiatry: Nepal longitudinal, ethnically diverse communities; community support structures (social capital/cohesion) associated with lower depression incidence; natural experiment (find the correct PMID by title/author)

Watt 2026 Lancet Public Health TOGETHER trial: multicentre RCT of Strengthening Families, Strengthening Communities group programme; 674 participants, 62% ethnic minority; 13 weeks; improved parental mental well-being post-programme and at 6 months
